Stage 5: Inactivity, Complaints and Changes of the Terms
blocks.summary: Three rules of the terms that touch an account: inactivity, complaints about account decisions and changes of the terms.
connections: customer support to request a review of a dispute or an account decision
blocks.notes: Three facts, exactly as in the Brand Information: prolonged inactivity may trigger an account review or closure under the applicable terms; a dispute or an account decision is reviewed when the player contacts customer support; the operator may modify promotional and contractual terms and publishes updates on the site. No time limits, no named regulator or ombudsman, no dispute deadlines and no promise of an outcome. Calm and factual.

blocks.summary: What a logged-in player gets from the VIP programme: five tiers, points from real-money play, the extra benefits and the terms.
connections: VIP points through eligible real-money gameplay, which unlock reward levels
blocks.notes: Five tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. Points are earned through eligible real-money gameplay and unlock numbered reward levels. Additional benefits: personalised offers, VIP cashback, higher withdrawal limits and a personal VIP manager for eligible high tiers. Terms: reward and withdrawal limits may differ by VIP level and currency, and level-based benefits and eligibility may change under the programme rules. Do not give level numbers, point thresholds, rewards or limits (they are on the VIP page) and do not use the official name of the programme (it contains the brand name).

blocks.heading: Account Lifecycle FAQ
blocks.summary: 8 short questions and answers on the login and the account.
blocks.notes: A bulleted list of 8 items in the form "- **Question?** Answer." (bold question, then a one-sentence answer); bold is required here for the question text only. Questions, in this order: (1) which details registration asks for (e-mail, password, legal name, date of birth, residential address); (2) how to log in (with the registered e-mail and password, as the page explains); (3) what to do after a forgotten password (request a reset link with the registered e-mail); (4) which identity document is accepted (passport, national identity card or driving licence); (5) how fast a withdrawal request is processed (generally within three working days; do not promise a payout time); (6) what prolonged inactivity can lead to (an account review or closure under the terms); (7) how to close the account (through customer support); (8) where to turn when the login still fails (customer support: live chat 24/7 or e-mail; do not print the e-mail address). Answers repeat the facts of the sections of the page in other words and add nothing new. Do not answer questions about multiple devices, lockouts or login limits: no data.
